mutableInjection.reason: Documented native Playwright evaluate APIs are read-only. Browser capabilities: visibility and viewport. Tab capabilities: pageAssets and webmcp. No supported mutable title or script insertion API is exposed.

manualEvidence.evidence: Interactive SVG has role img and pointer handlers, without tabindex or keyboard handlers. Native AX exposes both boards as images. No keyboard answer selection path is provided.
manualEvidence.classification: Manual accessibility observation, outside detector rule result.

manualEvidence.evidence: Difficulty buttons are40px high on both tested viewports; settings close41.125×44px; phone theme43px high and brand37.5px high. Gameplay buttons/help remain48px high.
manualEvidence.classification: Minor usability observation; 44px is a conservative touch target heuristic, not a claim of WCAG2.2 AA failure.

manualEvidence.issue: Help overlays first board while open
manualEvidence.evidence: Phone help occupiesx34..374,y128..241.586; first image startsy137. Help overlaps104.586px of first image height. Same help button toggles it closed.
manualEvidence.classification: Tradeoff; not a blocker and not evidence of overflow.
